summary: The most internally consistent and decomposition-ready of the three. Round 2 closed nearly every round-1 gap: it now has a rigorous turn-envelope/receipt/resume reliability protocol (§5), a fresh cross-model adjudicator that resolves disputes by evidence and demands a deterministic experiment rather than model voting (§7.3), a standalone reusable review-loop that cannot mint COMPLETE without E2E (§11), a real missing-tools escalation protocol (§8), and disciplined in-code wontfix rationale (§7.4). It uniquely and cleanly solves the verification-state SHA recursion (post-COMPLETE metadata-only commit referencing the parent revision, §4.11), matches the literal four-role model set (§6.2), enforces the symbol link in the linter (§10.6), and integrates knowledge during execution so it gets reviewed. Residual issues are enhancement-level omissions, not contradictions: no first-class orchestrator context budget / pre-compaction escalation (the author's top fear, though §9.1 SESSION_LOST makes orchestrator loss recoverable), and no explicit global alternation cycle bound. I tried to break its core mechanics and could not.

blocking_findings.description: Despite orchestrator compaction being the author's foremost concern, there is still no first-class context budget, warn threshold, or pre-compaction escalation; only reactive SESSION_LOST recovery exists.
blocking_findings.required_change: Add an orchestrator context budget with a warn threshold and escalate-before-the-danger-line, ideally by persisting run state as a reconstructable on-disk file (as proposal-3 does) rather than only in the backend.

blocking_findings.description: No explicit global bound on the REVIEW/E2E alternation; churn is bounded only per-finding via the two-rebuttal→adjudicator rule and taste/wontfix handling.
blocking_findings.required_change: Add an explicit global cycle budget with escalation-on-exceed, as a backstop distinct from per-finding adjudication.

non_blocking_findings.description: How knowledge-lint identifies 'the closed tracked feature-spec' it must assert is gone still requires threading the spec locator from run state; unchanged from round 1.

assumptions: The four-role model set (adjudicator reusing a confirmed reviewer model, no fifth saved role) is treated as literal compliance with the task's 'четырёх ролей'; the orchestrator's model is chosen when the user launches it.
'Run state хранится backend' is acceptable because the backend must satisfy the 'store small structured run state' capability (§9); otherwise the backend is rejected.
